title: High-Performance Solid-State PbS Quantum Dot-Sensitized Solar Cells Prepared by Introduction of Hybrid Perovskite Interlayer

source_inventory.title: High-Performance Solid-State PbS Quantum Dot-Sensitized Solar Cells Prepared by Introduction of Hybrid Perovskite Interlayer
source_inventory.scope: The author and independent auditor each read all seven main and eight SI pages as text and original-page images: TiO2 substrate and 15-cycle PbS preparation, 1/2.5/5 wt% MAPbI3 coatings, four device classes, Al2O3 and TiO2 PL contexts, glass and MAPbI3-only controls, source tables and conflicts. External full recipes and unprinted curve values are excluded.
source_conflicts: SI p.2 second 100 mL/5 mM stock phrase omits its compound name. Main p.2 explicitly reports 5 mM Na2S in water/methanol and the adjacent SI sequence identifies Na2S; retain this cross-source qualification.
Figure 3b caption labels Pb2p; main prose identifies Pb4f. Both refer to the same panel; no silent relabeling.
Table 1 average FF values and ± terms are fractional-looking numbers under an FF(%) header; best rows andFigureS5 use tens-of-percent values. Original numbers/units retained without rescaling.
Table 1 footnote states Average=standard deviation of30 samples; average/statistical wording remains as printed.
Main p.5 prose pristine PCE 4.5%, versusTable 1 best andmain p.2 overview 4.8%; both values retained.
Main p.6 calls the sequence 1025→1035→1055 nm gradually blue-shifted, although those printed wavelengths increase before 780 nm for 5MA. Preserve the verbal claim and numerical sequence.
Figure 5a,b caption and discussion place static/transientPL onmp-Al2O3; main p.6 attribution ofsecondary780nm feature mentions bare mp-TiO2. Do not silently transfer this measurement toTiO2.
SI3 supplies650 nm/10 MHz forTiO2 TRPL; exact pulsed conditions forAl2O3 TRPL are not separately stated.
Prose quenching order 0<1<5<2.5 is retained alongsideTable S1 average lifetimes 2.91, 2.41, 2.19, 1.89 ns; no reordered table or inferred crosswalk.

Main p.6 assigns the near-infrared PL maxima as pristine approximately 1025 nm, 1MA approximately 1035 nm and 2.5MA approximately 1055 nm. Figure 5a on main p.5 instead labels the black pristine maximum rightmost, red 1MA intermediate and green 2.5MA leftmost. The prose and labeled figure therefore disagree on sample assignment/order. Both are retained unresolved; no exact plotted maxima are inferred. This three-peak ordering conflict does not separately contradict the approximately 780 nm 5MA feature or the TRPL panels.
limitations: No inferred physical batch identity among source-associated samples.
No raw curve digitization, measured atomic coordinates or training eligibility.
Source figure reuse permission remains unverified.

figures.label: Figure 5
figures.caption_paraphrase: Original Figure 5. Static PL and TRPL on Al2O3 and TRPL on TiO2 are separate substrate contexts. Panel a is Al2O3 static PL, b Al2O3 TRPL, c TiO2 TRPL; no cross-substrate specimen join. Panel-a assignment conflict: the near-infrared maxima are labeled black/pristine rightmost, red/1MA intermediate and green/2.5MA leftmost, whereas main p.6 assigns approximately 1025, 1035 and 1055 nm to pristine, 1MA and 2.5MA respectively. Neither source representation is selected as correct; no numerical plot peaks are inferred. The 5MA approximately 780 nm feature and panels b/c are not contradicted by this order conflict.
